name: plaro
description: Your project's agreed requirements and what changed, from PLARO: tools to read them, change notices when you send a message, the commands plan_changes · plan_project · check_acceptance, and — each call approved by you — questions for the PM, what was built, and (on your own PLARO account) passed acceptance checks. Sign in from /mcp: with your PLARO account, or with the address your PM connected.
